what: Three bundles of glowing signature lines (bottom, middle, top, six lines per bundle) flow with a slow swell on a dark stage — each bundle twists more the farther it is from the stage center (log radius × rotation) so the lines fan out, and line color passes between three accent colors line by line. Only lines near the mouse (radius 6.5) bend toward the mouse height, and the whole screen is pushed .2 of the way away from the mouse — both chase by .05 of the remaining distance each frame. It starts once the page is fully loaded and idle, and a light panel rises over 1s (WebGL shader)

options.gap: Gap between lines in a bundle (share of screen height), default .515
options.radius: Narrowness of the mouse bend radius (larger is narrower), default 6.5
options.bend: Bend strength, default 2 — 0 means no bend
options.follow: Share that mouse and push follow per frame, default .05
options.parallax: Share of screen push, default .2 — 0 means no push
options.low · mid · top: Bundle positions “x y rotation”, default low 2 -0.7 -1 · mid 5 0 0.2 · top 10 0.5 -0.4 (the top bundle flips left and right)
options.wait: With none, it starts right away without waiting for the page to load (default is when idle after load)
options.--fx-line-1…8: Line color (css variable, only if set) — the basic three surround the accent color
options.--fx-fade: Time for the light panel to rise (css variable), default 1s

note: The light board goes in as the element’s first child (.fx-glb) and sits at z-index −1 — isolation is set on the element to contain it, so the text stays on top without its own z-index. If the stage has a light skin, it is screen, so the lines look faint. On devices without a pointer and under reduced motion it does not bend, and with reduced motion only one frame is drawn.

from.where: index.html Hero, pricing section and the Contact band on every page (original HeroLines — 6 lines · spacing 51.5 · speed 1.9 · bend radius 6.5 · intensity 2 · follow .05 · push .2 · colors teal·orange·magenta, started with requestIdleCallback after load and fading up over 1000ms ease-out)
